title: GÜB Operational Overview
summary: General overview of GÜB operations and organizational structure.
content:
GÜB Operational Overview

This document provides a general overview of GÜB operations, covering organizational structure, mission directives, and standard operating procedures.

All personnel are expected to familiarize themselves with this document upon onboarding.

title: Field Protocol Manual
summary: Standard field protocols for Level three operatives.
content:
Field Protocol Manual

This manual outlines the standard field protocols to be followed during all authorized operations. Deviations require written authorization from a Level 9 or higher officer.

title: Designation 6.7 — Special Access Materials
summary: Materials restricted to personnel with Authorization Level 6.7.
content:
Designation 6.7 — Special Access Materials

This document contains materials classified under the special 6.7 designation. Access is restricted to personnel with explicit Authorization Level 6.7 or Authorization Level 18+.

Contents of this file are compartmentalized and must not be discussed outside of authorized channels.

title: Intelligence Summary — Q1 2026
content:
Intelligence Summary — Q1 2026

CLASSIFIED — This quarterly intelligence summary covers key developments, threat assessments, and operational intelligence gathered during Q1 2026.

Distribution is limited to Level 9 (CLASSIFIED) personnel and above.

Threat Assessment Matrix

title: OMEGA Directive
content:
OMEGA Directive

LEVEL OMEGA — This document contains the highest-level directives governing GÜB operations. Access is restricted to personnel with Level 18+ (LEVEL OMEGA) clearance.

The contents of this directive supersede all prior operational mandates.
